schema.title: Response List Saved Api Scenarios Get

AddConnection.title: AddConnection
AddConnection.description:
An existing route also runs directly between two stops (an extension or
a shortcut). At least one of the stops must already be on the route.

AddRoute.title: AddRoute
AddRoute.description:
A new bus line through stops that exist (or were added by an earlier
change), in order. ``travel_times_min[i]`` is the time from stop i to
stop i+1; a loop has one more, from the last stop back to the first.
The user gives every time and the headway (nothing is guessed).

AddStop.title: AddStop
AddStop.description:
A new stop inserted into a route between two consecutive stops: the
route's buses now run from -> new stop -> to (and back, if the route runs
both ways). The user gives both travel times.

ChangeFrequency.title: ChangeFrequency
ChangeFrequency.description: The route runs every ``headway_min`` minutes (affects waiting time only).

ChangeTravelTime.title: ChangeTravelTime
ChangeTravelTime.description: Set a new travel time (minutes) on the link, for every route using it.

CloseStop.title: CloseStop
CloseStop.description: Nobody can board, alight or transfer at the stop; buses drive through.

ComparisonResult.title: ComparisonResult
ComparisonResult.description:
Every number is computed by comparison_service from two fresh simulations.

Journeys are the baseline's ordered stop pairs; a journey to or from a stop
that A or B closes (with walking off) is left out of the journey counts.

to_or_from_closed_stop_pct.title: To Or From Closed Stop Pct

DemandWeighted.title: DemandWeighted
DemandWeighted.description:
The same figures weighted by INVENTED demand: a journey weighs
origin activity x destination activity (stop levels 1-3). Only shares
and averages: absolute passenger numbers would be fake data.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Shape of the /api/health response (validated by Pydantic).

InterpretResponse.title: InterpretResponse
InterpretResponse.description:
``ok``: ``changes`` is the complete NEW change list (it may be empty, e.g.
after "undo the only change"), valid for the network; ``removed`` and
``replaced`` are numbers (1-based) in the current list, ``added`` how many
changes were appended. ``unclear``: nothing changes (``changes`` is empty);
``message`` explains why or asks for clarification.

JourneyChange.title: JourneyChange
JourneyChange.description: One origin -> destination journey whose fastest travel time changed.

JourneyDifference.title: JourneyDifference
JourneyDifference.description: One journey between baseline stops under both scenarios (None = impossible).

JourneyLeg.title: JourneyLeg
JourneyLeg.description: A stretch travelled on one route without changing bus.

NetworkOut.title: NetworkOut
NetworkOut.description: The whole baseline network in one response (used by the map).

NewStops.title: NewStops
NewStops.description:
Journeys to or from stops ADDED by the scenario. They have no "before",
so they are reported here and kept out of every other figure.

RemoveConnection.title: RemoveConnection
RemoveConnection.description: The link disappears for every route that uses it.

SavedScenarioIn.title: SavedScenarioIn
SavedScenarioIn.description: Create or overwrite: a name and a change list (1-20 changes).

SavedScenarioInfo.title: SavedScenarioInfo
SavedScenarioInfo.description:
One row of the list. ``fits`` = it applies to the CURRENT network
(checked on every listing); ``problem`` says why not.

Scenario.title: Scenario
Scenario.description: Changes are applied in the given order.

walked_to_or_from_closed_stop.title: Walked To Or From Closed Stop

StopImpact.title: StopImpact
StopImpact.description: Effect on journeys starting or ending at one stop.

SummaryResponse.title: SummaryResponse
SummaryResponse.description:
``ok``: ``summary`` is the AI's text with every number inserted by the
backend from the computed results. ``withheld``: the AI did not keep to the
rules (twice); ``summary`` is None and ``message`` says why.

WalkLeg.title: WalkLeg
WalkLeg.description: Walking to or from a closed stop (straight line x detour factor).
